description: Complaint records that must be rejected, each with the reason.

cases.name: missing_reference
cases.why: reference is required and unique. It is the complaint's identity in the originating system; without it the same complaint re-ingested becomes two.

cases.name: missing_reported_at
cases.why: reported_at is required. The correlation window is anchored on it, so a complaint with no date cannot be matched to activity at all.

cases.name: empty_narrative
cases.why: narrative_raw has a minimum length of one. An empty narrative is indistinguishable from a truncation or an extraction failure upstream.

cases.name: zero_amount
cases.why: amount is optional but must be greater than zero when present. A zero loss is better expressed by omitting the field.

cases.name: currency_without_amount_wrong_length
cases.why: currency must be a three-letter code when present.

cases.name: unknown_victim_account
cases.why: victim_account_id is a foreign key. A complaint naming an account the ledger does not hold is a real situation — the account may be at another bank — and the correct handling is to leave the field empty, not to invent the account.

cases.name: reported_at_in_the_future
cases.why: A complaint cannot be filed after now beyond clock skew. A future-dated complaint would open a correlation window over activity that has not happened.
